notes.title: Aldro Resurrection Update! Release v2.0
notes.content:
*Aldro Resurrection Update Patch Notes* v2.0



[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/mhuIcZE66mE?si=1m6j1FAs12IueCIi"][/dynamiclink]

Core Gameplay Systems:

-Introduced Normal Mode and Hard Mode:

	-Normal Mode: Players retain inventory after death.

	-Hard Mode: Features item loss on death, tougher enemies, and double loot rewards.

-Added Advanced Mouse Tracking Camera Movement (toggleable) — camera now subtly sways with mouse movement.

-Implemented a dynamic lighting system that darkens the environment during nighttime and in underground areas, enhancing atmosphere and immersion.

-Implemented a 24-Hour Day/Night Cycle, adding time-based gameplay variation.

-Introduced a new Slot Stash: A new early game placeable container with cross-save shared storage

-Pets can be found in jars throughout the world and collected by breaking them.

-Home raids have been overhauled with new enemy mobs and rebalanced for improved challenge and gameplay.

-Mobs now drop Mana/HP.



User Interface (UI) Overhaul:

-The on-screen hotbar (slots 1–7) now allows instant building, consuming, or equipping upon pressing the corresponding number key—removing the previous confirmation step for faster gameplay.

-Reworked Tutorial UI for improved user onboarding.

-Redesigned Crafting Menu UI for better navigation.

-Overhauled the Main Menu UI for a fresh layout.

-Updated Death Screen UI with improved visuals and clarity.

-Replaced all fonts with a new universal font for better readability.

-The Crafting, Inventory, and Market Menu now display nametags when hovering over items.

-Overhauled the item bar to improve layout and usability, preventing it from overlapping or extending beyond the screen during market and crafting menu use.

-Screenshake has been increased.



Mana System Overhauled:

-Mana no longer auto-regenerates while casting.

-Upgrading regeneration now offers more meaningful benefits.

-Mana Regeneration Rating has been replaced by Mana Regeneration percentage above base similar to all other stats. 



Crafting System Updates:

-Added Workbench Requirements.

-Some crafting recipes now require one of 6 new workbench types.

-Guns & Ammo are now craftable at the Weaponsmith Workbench.

-Numerous crafting recipes have been adjusted for smoother progression, with corresponding market price updates to maintain balance.

Casino:

-The Casino — A new world structure that can be found or built. Inside are 3 playable games:

	-Blackjack

	-Ride the Bus

	-Slot Machines



New Artifact Slot System:

-Introduced 16 New Artifacts — a new equipment type that grants unique gameplay-altering abilities rather than modifying stats. Examples include: flight, freezing enemies, passive DPS support, spawning hp/mana stars, and many other things.

-Players can equip up to 2 artifacts at once.

-Added a craftable Artifacts "Resurrection Totem" prevents Aldro's death once, granting him a second chance at life upon defeat.



New Weapon Additions:

-3 Guns: MP5, Spade Slinger, Tactical Shotgun

-7 Craftable Swords (1 per element tier)

-13 Magic Rods — a new mana-based weapon class with projectile attacks

-Introduced three powerful new Rainbow Rarity weapons which have been added to the auction house:

	-Spade Slinger – Fires shots that deal a random damage value between 1 and 100.

	-Rod of Null Energy – Summons a barrage of homing rainbow stars.

	-Rod of Aureorum – Calls forth an army of golden skeletons to fight alongside you.



Items & Potions:

-Added Large Mana & HP Potions that restore 75 points.

-Vases now drop potions when broken.

-Added new Craftable light sources: Torches, Glowsticks, Braziers, and Standing Eridium Torches.

-Added a Clock Object that displays in-game time.

-Added 6 new crafting ingredients used in creating Rods, Structures, and select Artifacts.



Enemies & Bosses:

-New Core Boss: Nekrathul, summonable only at night using a special artifact.

-Introduced new tameable wolf mob — tame with bones.

-Added a new neutral lizard mob native to the tropical biome.

-Introduced Rats around the darker area of Aldro.

-Agro Mobs now spawn in all biomes. 

-Introduced Phoenixes, rare creatures found during expeditions — they drop a valuable feather used in high-tier crafting recipes.

-Added 4 new Night-Time Mobs:

	-Darkrog

	-Nightcrawlers

	-TNT Goblins

	-Imps

-Bosses now despawn when the player is defeated.

-Significantly improved enemy AI with pathfinding capabilities — enemies can now intelligently navigate around obstacles to reach and engage their targets.

-AI that use basic hand-to-hand combat now keep a respectful distance when on cooldown from attacking again. 



World Content & Environments:

-Added wind simulation to small foliage for visual realism.

-Tomb Biome overhaul.

-Mobs now spawn more consistently during generation.

-Map drop rates increased, unlocking new levels is now more accessible.

-Crate drops have been increased.

-Air drops have been decreased now that ammo is craftable.

-Magic projectiles now emit a glowing effect accompanied by dynamic particle trails.



New Zones:

-The Backrooms; a surreal, liminal space found randomly during expeditions. This eerie zone contains unpredictable, randomly generated loot and the elusive Almond Water, essential for survival.

-The Tomb: A mysterious underground chamber located within the Tomb biome, featuring a unique sacrificial trial that, once completed, rewards Aldro with the powerful Amulet of the Undead needed to summon Nekrathul.



Progression & Achievements:

-Added 2 new quests to expand progression.

-Added 5 new Steam Achievements.



Fixes & Stability:

-Windows mode no longer resizes when entering a new level.

-Placing a new home flag now resets raid time.

-Flying no longer fly's over indoor areas.

-Fixed fatal errors causing crashes or instability.

notes.title: Hotfix "v1.0.06"
notes.content:
Small Hotfix:

-Lumberyards now indicate tree harvest range with a green circle.
-The "Help Wanted" quest has been re-worded and fixed to accommodate lumberyards. You are required to now place a worker hut near a lumberyard/mining node. Once the station is activated you will then be awarded the quest progression.

notes.title: Hotfix "v1.0.05"
notes.content: -Random Boxes now spawn at the originally intended rate. (25% chance per level)

notes.title: Hotfix "v1.0.04"
notes.content:
Critical Hotfix:

Fix an issue where the Home Raid Accumulation meter would not trigger a raid as intended. Reworked the core mechanics of the script to enhance reliability. This issue was primarily observed on high-end PCs, where the frame rate would either skip lower tiers or fail to ignite at stage five keeping the player permanently stuck at tier five.

Players can now expect a fair roll at lower tiers. Chances of raid ignition have not changed at 55% chance per stage.

notes.title: Hotfix "v1.0.02"
notes.content:
Gameplay Enhancements:

-UI tabs (aka the right-hand slide out tabs) now feature titles that clearly indicate the menu they represent.
-Large rocks now yield 50% more resources than previously.
-Crates now contain Trilliants.
-Trilliants now have a chance to spawn randomly throughout the world.
-Updated descriptions for Trilliants and Gloob Crystals to clearly specify their uses.
-Increased the spawn rate of Mysterious Chests.
-Guide Quests; Added four new guide quests to help new players understand important features that were previously unexplained.
-Quest Progression; Reorganized quests based on feedback from beta testers to better match the average progression order.

notes.title: Hotfix "v1.0.01"
notes.content:
Small Hotfix:

Gameplay Enhancements:

-The map will now spawn 20% more often to unlock new biomes.
-Snow Staff's spawn rate has been increased by 25%.

Quality of Life Improvements:

-The number keys allocated to the on screen hotbar will now be directed to the radial menu. This allows for a smoother experience without forced -mouse movements.
-Simple Font has been overhauled and is now the Default Font when loading Aldro for the first time.
-Cursor size can now be adjusted in your settings.
-Cursor has been overhauled to improve interaction with clicking.
-Patched various UI bugs when operating controllers and keyboards simultaneously.
-MISC bug fixes.

notes.title: Hotfix "v0.1.0.71" LIVE
notes.content:
-Increased map spawns from 9% chance to a 12.5% chance to spawn in a world.
-Auction bids have been reduced, additionally auction times have been reduced. This will decrease the total prices items will sell for making it more affordable.
-The Build Point system has been extended. Stands=1, Towers=1.5, and Shard Towers=4. Total Max of 25 Points to be placed.

notes.content: -x1 New auction item added, this item will have unlimited durability. This is the first tool focused auction item.

notes.title: Hotfix "v0.1.0.6" LIVE
notes.content:
-Unborno Pet will no longer make you invincible.
-Home flags now show a warning if it will be deleting an existing home.

notes.title: New Update! Patch notes "v0.1.0.6" LIVE
notes.content:
Major Content Update:

-NEW! Auction house. The auction house will spawn randomly and can be entered.
-Added a new rarity; Rainbow! This is assigned to auction items that can only be obtained through winning an auction.
-Added x2 new melees.
-Added x6 new pets.
-Added the Albino Mor egg, this can only be obtained at auctions.
-Added new resource; Coal! This can be used as fuel and in crafting.
-Added new item; Crying Shrine! This can be used to increase the raid accumulation.
-Decreased base raid accumulation by 33%.
-Biome Revamp! Snow, Tropical, and Lava biomes have been completely overhauled. The Snow Biome is now less cluttered giving Aldro more room to roam.
-Friendly AI will now spawn on Farmland/Floors.
-Added interactive buttons to signify hot-slot items.
-Follower's now die with you when outside home.
-Fixed rendering issues pertaining to loading empty rooms.
-Re-worded "Equipping Useables" Quest to be more clear on the task.
-Added x4 new Steam achievements.
-MISC Bug fixes.

notes.title: Patch Notes "v0.1.0.3"
notes.content:
Patch Notes "v0.1.0.3"

-Banks have been implemented along with a universal character currency.
-Blacksmiths now appear around the map and are craftable.
-Heavy Alloy Processing has now been added.
-Revamped the Equipped item system to allow for more complex melees.
-Staffs have been re-worked to have healing abilities.
-Umbrellas have been added.
-Added the Defense Stand, a cheaper cost defense tower manned by residents.
-Revamped Save System to allow for real-time updates without corrupting.
-Added a Control Menu to view source controls.
-Balanced loot tables & market prices.
-Added Zoom keybinds "-+"
-Added 4 new Radio Songs in rotation.
-Added 8 new steam achievements.
-Fixed 3 Fatal Errors & MISC Bug Fixes.
